name: jairf-assets
description: JAIRF digital assets roadmap (per Meshy_3D_Asset_Lists_by_Quarter.md). Copy-paste Meshy text-to-3D prompts: per-quarter asset lists (characters, weapons, environment, inventory props, builder modular pieces, hero assets). Pipeline: Meshy generate -> remesh to poly budget -> AI texturing PBR -> auto-rig -> FBX/GLB import to Unity. One consistent art-style keyword across all prompts.

phases.name: 1. Art direction lock (style keyword + prompt formula)
2. Q1 asset set: characters, weapons, starter zone, inventory
3. Q2 asset set: zones, non-player chars, social props
4. Q3 asset set: classes, modular builder pieces, furnishing
5. Q4 asset set: hero assets, biome expansion, advanced builder
6. Meshy texture/rig pipeline (remesh, PBR, auto-rig, FBX/GLB)
